Douglas Holtz-Eakin, economic policy adviser to Republican presidential candidate John McCain, [talks to Bloomberg’s Tom Keene (mp3)](http://media.bloomberg.com/bb/avfile/BBRECON/v5RnvyN49Ytw.mp3 "talks to Bloomberg’s Tom Keene (mp3)") about why McCain is the only candidate he has ever worked for.
